Get involved

Four ways to get involved this season

  1. 01

    Walk with us

    One Thursday night a month, in teams of three, carrying hot meals and warm clothing.

    See shifts
  2. 02

    Give at a food drive

    Add one item to your cart at a partner grocery store in your neighbourhood.

    Find a food drive
  3. 03

    Organize your own

    Church, school or office: a complete toolkit to launch your own food drive.

    Open the toolkits
  4. 04

    Carry it in prayer

    Get three prayer requests every Monday for the teams and the families.

Our help

Four areas of help, always free

Missions

  • Food

    Food baskets, hot meals on outreach walks and grocery-store food drives.

  • Clothing

    Coats, boots, wool socks and toques to get through winter.

  • School

    Supplies, lunch boxes and tutoring for orphans.

  • Material or financial

    Practical help when everything else falls short.
